talk.text: Talking: one button, words where you can see them

why.text:
Design direction

• Where your words go is the biggest thing on Talk, because sending text to the wrong place is the costly mistake.
• Dictation is blue and AI Control is indigo, so the mode is visible at a glance, not only in a switch.
• The talk button is the one strong element. Glass is only for controls floating above content, as Apple's Liquid Glass guidance says.
• Four tabs: Talk, History, Devices, Agents. Suggestions appear on Talk in AI Control, and Settings is the gear.
• Type is Inter here as a stand-in for Apple's SF Pro, which the app uses.
